name: Intended Effect Set
meaning: Complete set of intended economically consequential mutations

name: Observed Mutation Set
meaning: Mutations whose occurrence is reported by a conformant observation mechanism

name: Committed Mutation Set
meaning: Mutations established to have crossed an applicable commitment boundary

name: Economically Recognized Effect Set
meaning: Mutations presently recognized as economically consequential effects attributable to the execution

name: Established Occurrence Set
meaning: Intended mutations whose occurrence can currently be established

name: Established Non-Occurrence Set
meaning: Intended mutations whose non-occurrence can currently be established

name: Determinate Knowledge Set
meaning: Union of established occurrence and established non-occurrence sets

name: Unresolved Mutation Set
meaning: Intended mutations whose occurrence status remains unresolved
